periods.label: 力量巨大但心智幼小的BIG BABY

status.current: runs away crying from Caldia after Alice Ascaride scolds him
status.condition: right eye wounded by Ikki, foot cut by Alice, frightened

relationships.or-gaule: Only friendlike figure among the faction; Or-Gaule defends his behavior to Ein.
relationships.ein: Accomplice whose blood roses he tries to eat, angering her.
relationships.alice-ascaride: Adult authority figure whose scolding makes him apologize and flee.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Blinded in one eye by Ikki's Saigeki and chases him away from the troops.

periods.summary: B.B. joins Or-Gaule's breakaway faction and appears at Rebellion headquarters after Ein has killed the remaining Apostles, childishly trying to eat her bloody flowers. At Caldia he suddenly manifests as a thirty-meter giant, crushes the helicopter carrying Ikki and Milialia, and throws slabs of road like toys, killing soldiers. Ikki blinds one eye and lures him away from central avenue; after electric wires slow him, B.B. grows to over three hundred meters and nearly stomps Ikki. Alice Ascaride stops the stomp through Unbreakable, cuts his foot, then removes her helmet and scolds him. Because B.B. is mentally a five-year-old child, he apologizes and flees in tears.

key_events.summary: Appears among Or-Gaule's invited accomplices and reveals his childish appetite.
Destroys the helicopter, chases Ikki, grows massively, and is driven off by Alice.

abilities: giantification to 30 meters and over 300 meters
